Exercise: Internal Rotation with Band

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
None

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_shoulder_internal_rotation

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- bands

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improving_shoulder_flexibility
- shoulder_strength_and_stability

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Recent shoulder surgery

Exercise Variations:

- variation_name: Band Resistance Level Increase, description: Increase the resistance of the band to challenge the muscles further.
- variation_name: Single Arm Dumbbell Internal Rotation, equipment: dumbbells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Internal Shoulder Rotation with Cable Machine, equipment: cable machine

Instructions:

- Choke the band around a post. The band should be at the same height as your elbow. Stand with your right side to the band a couple of feet away.
- Grasp the end of the band with your right hand, and keep your elbow pressed firmly to your side. We recommend you hold a pad or foam roll in place with your elbow to keep it firmly in position.
- With your upper arm in position, your elbow should be flexed to 90 degrees with your hand reaching away from your torso. This will be your starting position.
- Execute the movement by rotating your arm in a forehand motion, keeping your elbow in place.
- Continue as far as you are able, pause, and then return to the starting position.
